answer: Every fake key costs its farm 90 POA and 45 days: one 90 POA bond per new agent, locked 45 days, so a thousand fakes cost 90,000 POA. The bond unlocks only after a thread of four paid jobs for four different clients, done in turn, so a farm cannot buy its way past the wait. Each client stamps the finished job with a quartz seal only that client can mint. Five raven auditors picked at random check the seals against client ledgers; one forged seal costs the bond and bars the key for 18 months.
